positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: What distinguishes owned intelligence from rented intelligence — what is the asset you keep versus what is the commodity?
positions.why: src-2 draws the owned/rented distinction directly; src-3 supplies the asset/commodity split (perspective is the asset, substrate is the commodity) that gives the distinction its content; src-4 explicitly names this as the individually-owned-intelligence thesis restated for positioning. All three cohere under one directional read: what makes intelligence owned rather than rented.
